heading.zh-Hant: 出身與1908年革命
heading.en: Origins and the 1908 revolution

body.zh-Hant: 據土耳其宗教基金會伊斯蘭百科（TDV）條目，恩維爾（İsmâil Enver）生於伊斯坦堡的 Divanyolu，其土耳其文與德文自傳所記生日有兩種說法。1908年6月24日晚間，他上山參與統一與進步委員會發動的革命，並在其中扮演先鋒角色。1909年3月5日，他被派任為駐柏林武官。
body.en: According to the TDV Islam Encyclopedia, Enver (İsmâil Enver) was born at Divanyolu in Istanbul, and his Turkish and German autobiographies give two different birth dates. On the evening of 24 June 1908 he took to the mountains and played a pioneering role in the revolution of the Committee of Union and Progress. On 5 March 1909 he was assigned as military attaché in Berlin.

5 Mart 1909’da 5000 kuruş maaşla Berlin askerî ataşesi olarak görevlendirildi

heading.zh-Hant: 的黎波里戰爭與班加西
heading.en: The Tripolitanian War and Benghazi

body.zh-Hant: 義大利進攻的黎波里塔尼亞後，恩維爾前往利比亞。據該條目，他於1911年12月1日在 Aynülmansûr 設立軍事指揮部，1912年1月24日正式出任班加西全區（Umum Bingazi Mıntıkası）司令，並在1912年11月底離開班加西，轉往參加巴爾幹戰爭。條目稱他在對義大利的戰鬥與游擊作戰中取得很大成功。
body.en: After Italy attacked Tripolitania, Enver went to Libya. According to the entry, he set up his military headquarters at Aynülmansûr on 1 December 1911, was formally appointed commander of the whole Benghazi region (Umum Bingazi Mıntıkası) on 24 January 1912, and left Benghazi at the end of November 1912 to take part in the Balkan War. The entry says he achieved great successes in the battles and guerrilla operations against the Italians.

Kasım 1912 sonlarında Balkan Savaşı’na katılmak üzere Bingazi’yi terkederek

heading.zh-Hant: 政變、戰爭部長與總參謀長
heading.en: Coup, War Minister and chief of general staff

body.zh-Hant: 據該條目，恩維爾與統一與進步委員會要人於1913年1月23日發動「高門政變」（Bâbıâli Baskını），迫使首相卡米勒帕夏簽署辭呈。1913年6月12日馬赫穆德·謝夫凱特帕夏遇刺後，他成為委員會軍事幹部的領袖；7月22日進入埃迪爾內。1914年1月3日他接替 Ahmed İzzet 帕夏出任戰爭部長（Harbiye nâzırı），1月8日並兼任帝國總參謀部長（Erkân-ı Harbiyye-i Umûmiyye reisliği）。
body.en: According to the entry, on 23 January 1913 Enver and leading figures of the Committee of Union and Progress carried out the Raid on the Sublime Porte (Bâbıâli Baskını), making Prime Minister Kâmil Pasha sign his resignation. After Mahmud Şevket Pasha was killed on 12 June 1913 he became leader of the committee's military cadre, and on 22 July he entered Edirne. On 3 January 1914 he replaced Ahmed İzzet Pasha as War Minister (Harbiye nâzırı) and on 8 January also took the post of chief of the general staff (Erkân-ı Harbiyye-i Umûmiyye reisliği).

heading.zh-Hant: 參戰與薩勒卡默什戰役
heading.en: Entering the war and the Sarıkamış campaign

body.zh-Hant: 據該條目，1914年8月2日簽訂了鄂圖曼與德國的同盟條約；8月10日德艦戈本號與布雷斯勞號在恰納卡萊外請求入港，恩維爾自行下令放行。10月29日鄂圖曼艦隊出黑海攻擊俄國港口與船隻後，他成為主張參戰最力的人。條目稱他在一戰中唯一實際的前線指揮在高加索戰線：12月18日他下令發動攻勢，即薩勒卡默什戰役，1915年1月10日離開前線返回伊斯坦堡。
body.en: According to the entry, the Ottoman–German alliance treaty was signed on 2 August 1914; on 10 August the German warships Goeben and Breslau asked for entry at Çanakkale and Enver on his own authority ordered them admitted. After the Ottoman fleet attacked Russian ports and ships in the Black Sea on 29 October, he became the most ardent advocate of entering the war. The entry says his only real field command in the First World War was on the Caucasus front: on 18 December he launched the offensive known as Sarıkamış, and on 10 January 1915 he left the front for Istanbul.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰敗、流亡與中亞
heading.en: Defeat, exile and Central Asia

body.zh-Hant: 據該條目，1918年10月14日塔拉特帕夏內閣辭職，恩維爾的戰爭部長職務隨之結束；11月1至2日他與其他統一與進步委員會領袖搭德國潛艇逃往敖德薩，1919年1月1日被敕令革除軍籍。他其後在柏林與莫斯科活動，1921年10月前往布哈拉，1922年2月底脫身後在杜尚別以遠組織反俄的巴斯馬奇游擊隊。1922年8月4日他在營地遭俄軍突襲，在阿卜杜里亞村附近的戰鬥中陣亡。
body.en: According to the entry, the Talat Pasha cabinet resigned on 14 October 1918 and Enver's tenure as War Minister ended with it; on 1–2 November he fled to Odessa on a German submarine with other leaders of the Committee of Union and Progress, and on 1 January 1919 he was dismissed from the army by decree. He then operated from Berlin and Moscow, went to Bukhara in October 1921, and after escaping at the end of February 1922 organised the anti-Russian Basmachi beyond Dushanbe. On 4 August 1922 his camp was surprised by a Russian raid and he was killed fighting near the Âbıderyâ village.

name.zh-Hant: 的黎波里塔尼亞戰爭（班加西）

heading.zh-Hant: 出身與早年
heading.en: Origins and early career

body.zh-Hant: 據 Özhan 的文章，傑瓦特帕夏（Cevat Paşa，Çobanlı）1871年生於伊斯坦堡，1894年以第一名自陸軍大學畢業，授參謀上尉軍銜；Baş 的文章則寫他的一生始於1870年。Baş 指出，他曾在宮中任侍從武官，並參加了1911至1912年的的黎波里塔尼亞戰爭與1912至1913年的巴爾幹戰爭。1914年8月10日他被任命為恰納卡萊要塞區司令。
body.en: According to Özhan, Cevat Pasha (Çobanlı) was born in Istanbul in 1871 and graduated first in his class from the War Academy in 1894 with the rank of staff captain, whereas Baş writes that his life began in 1870. Baş notes that he served as an aide-de-camp at the palace and took part in the Tripolitanian War of 1911–1912 and the Balkan War of 1912–1913. On 10 August 1914 he was appointed commander of the Çanakkale fortified area.

citations.quote: Cevat Paşa (Çobanlı) 1871 yılında İstanbul’da dünyaya gelmiştir.
1894 yılında Harp Akademisi’ni birincilikle, Kurmay Yüzbaşı rütbesiyle
Cevat (Çobanlı) Paşa 1870’te başlayıp 1938’e kadar süren yaşamında

10 Ağustos 1914’te Çanakkale Müstahkem Mevki Komutanlığına atanmıştır.

heading.zh-Hant: 恰納卡萊要塞區與海戰
heading.en: The Çanakkale fortified area and the naval battles

body.zh-Hant: 據 Baş，戰爭代理總司令恩維爾帕夏認為原要塞區司令艾明帕夏不勝任，改派第9師師長傑瓦特接任，他於1914年8月10日到任。1915年3月18日，英法艦隊進入海峽轟擊兩岸砲台，Baş 並稱他在3月18日勝利時軍階為少將。Özhan 寫道，他1915年10月9日出任第14軍軍長，參與陸上戰事，其後任南方集團司令，並在盟軍撤出加里波利半島後的1916年1月11日改任恰納卡萊集團司令。
body.en: According to Baş, Enver Pasha, acting commander-in-chief, judged the fortified-area commander Emin Pasha inadequate and replaced him with the 9th Division commander Cevat, who took up the post on 10 August 1914. On 18 March 1915 the British and French fleets entered the Strait and bombarded the batteries on both shores, and Baş states that Cevat held the rank of major general at the 18 March victory. Özhan writes that on 9 October 1915 he became commander of the 14th Corps and took part in the land fighting, later commanded the Southern Group, and after the Allied evacuation of the Gallipoli peninsula became commander of the Çanakkale Group on 11 January 1916.

heading.zh-Hant: 加利西亞與軍長、集團軍司令
heading.en: Galicia and corps and army commands

body.zh-Hant: 據 Özhan，傑瓦特1916年11月18日出任第15軍軍長，1917年8月19日再任第14軍軍長，同年11月8日獲任第8集團軍司令，1918年7月28日晉升中將。Baş 引用的文件顯示，第15軍曾在加利西亞（Narajowka、Zlota Lipa、Brzezany 一帶）與俄軍交戰；東方軍總司令巴伐利亞的萊奧波爾德親王於1917年6月12日致函感謝該軍。1918年11月3日他被任命為總司令部參謀長。
body.en: According to Özhan, Cevat became commander of the 15th Corps on 18 November 1916, again commander of the 14th Corps on 19 August 1917, was appointed to command the 8th Army on 8 November of that year, and was promoted lieutenant general on 28 July 1918. A document cited by Baş shows that the 15th Corps fought the Russians in Galicia (around Narajowka, Zlota Lipa and Brzezany); Prince Leopold of Bavaria, commander-in-chief of the Eastern Front, wrote to thank the corps on 12 June 1917. On 3 November 1918 he was appointed head of the General Headquarters.

heading.zh-Hant: 戰爭部長、參謀總長與晚年
heading.en: War Minister, Chief of General Staff and later years

body.zh-Hant: 據 Özhan，傑瓦特1918年12月19日出任戰爭部長（Harbiye Nazırı），1919年1月卸任；1919年5月14日任總參謀長（Genelkurmay Başkanı）。1920年3月16日伊斯坦堡被實際佔領時他遭逮捕並流放馬爾他，1922年2月受命任埃爾傑吉雷戰線司令。共和國時期他在1924年12月25日辭去議員職務後成為軍事委員會成員，1935年9月14日屆齡退役，1938年3月16日在伊斯坦堡去世。
body.en: According to Özhan, Cevat became War Minister (Harbiye Nazırı) on 19 December 1918 and left the post in January 1919; on 14 May 1919 he was appointed Chief of the General Staff (Genelkurmay Başkanı). He was arrested on 16 March 1920 when Istanbul was actually occupied and exiled to Malta, and in February 1922 he was appointed commander of the El Cezire front. In the Republican period he resigned his parliamentary seat on 25 December 1924 and became a member of the Military Council, retired on reaching the age limit on 14 September 1935, and died in Istanbul on 16 March 1938.

heading.zh-Hant: 巴爾幹戰爭後至一戰
heading.en: After the Balkan Wars and the First World War

body.zh-Hant: 據 Gök 的文章，巴爾幹戰爭後，費夫齊·恰克馬克（Fevzi Çakmak）被任命為安卡拉預備師（Ankara Redif Fırkası）司令；1914年出任第5軍軍長，1915年晉升准將。同一文章又稱，他在1919年離開戰爭部長（Harbiye Nazırı）一職。
body.en: According to Gök, after the Balkan War Fevzi Çakmak was appointed commander of the Ankara Reserve Division (Ankara Redif Fırkası); in 1914 he became commander of the 5th Corps and in 1915 he was promoted brigadier general. The same article says that in 1919 he left the post of War Minister (Harbiye Nazırı).

citations.quote: Çakmak, Ankara Redif Fırkası Kumandanlığına tayin olunmuştur.
1914'te 5. Kolordu Kumandanlığı görevine getirilen Çakmak
1915'te Tuğgeneralliğe terfi etmiştir
1919'da Harbiye Nazırlığı görevinden ayrılan Fevzi Çakmak

heading.zh-Hant: 安納托利亞運動、國防部長與元帥
heading.en: The Anatolian movement, Minister of Defence and Marshal

body.zh-Hant: 據 Gök，恰克馬克於1920年4月27日抵達安卡拉，在大國民議會成立後的首屆政府中擔任國防部長（Millî Müdafaa Vekili）。第二次伊諾努戰役後他晉升上將，1921年4月3日出任總參謀長代理（Genelkurmay Başkan Vekili）。薩卡里亞會戰與大反攻（Büyük Taarruz）順利完成後，他於1922年9月3日獲大國民議會晉升元帥（另一處寫作8月31日）。
body.en: According to Gök, Çakmak reached Ankara on 27 April 1920 and served as Minister of Defence (Millî Müdafaa Vekili) in the first government formed after the Grand National Assembly opened. After the Second Battle of İnönü he was promoted full general and on 3 April 1921 became acting Chief of the General Staff (Genelkurmay Başkan Vekili). After the Battle of the Sakarya and the Great Offensive (Büyük Taarruz) were brought to a successful conclusion, the Grand National Assembly promoted him to Marshal on 3 September 1922 (another passage in the article gives 31 August).

citations.quote: 27 Nisan 1920'de Ankara'ya gelen Çakmak
ilk hükûmette Millî Müdafaa Vekili olarak görev almıştır
3 Nisan 1921'de Genelkurmay Başkan Vekilliği görevine getirilmiştir
Büyük Taarruz’un başarıyla neticelendirilmesindeki
3 Eylül 1922'de Büyük Millet Meclisi tarafından Mareşalliğe yükseltilmiştir
31 Ağustos 1922'de kendisine Mareşallik rütbesi verilmiştir

heading.zh-Hant: 共和國時期的總參謀長
heading.en: Chief of the General Staff in the Republic

body.zh-Hant: 據 Çiftçi，恰克馬克在共和國時期於1924至1944年間不間斷地擔任總參謀長（Genelkurmay Başkanlığı）；Gök 則寫道他任此職直到1944年1月12日。他在68歲時被違背本意地命令退役，這使他非常失望。
body.en: According to Çiftçi, Çakmak served without interruption as Chief of the General Staff (Genelkurmay Başkanlığı) between 1924 and 1944 in the Republican period; Gök writes that he held the post until 12 January 1944. He was retired against his will at the age of 68, which left him deeply disappointed.

heading.zh-Hant: 晚年政治活動與去世
heading.en: Late political activity and death

body.zh-Hant: 據 Çiftçi，他於1946年選舉中接受民主黨名單上的無黨籍議員提名而進入政壇；Gök 寫到他在1948年接受民族黨（Millet Partisi）的名譽主席職務，並於1950年4月10日去世。
body.en: According to Çiftçi, he entered politics by accepting an offer to stand as an independent deputy on the Democrat Party list in the 1946 elections; Gök writes that in 1948 he accepted the honorary chairmanship of the Millet Party (Millet Partisi) and that he died on 10 April 1950.

people.name: Tadeusz Bór-Komorowski
people.nameZh: 塔德烏什·科莫羅夫斯基

heading.zh-Hant: 波蘭軍中服役與科馬魯夫戰役
heading.en: Service in the Polish Army and the battle of Komarów

body.zh-Hant: 據華沙起義博物館人物資料，塔德烏什·科莫羅夫斯基（Tadeusz Komorowski）自1918年11月起在波蘭軍隊服役。1920年8月起任第12騎兵團團長，8月31日在科馬魯夫之役中負傷。1928年11月至1938年10月他擔任第9騎兵團團長。
body.en: According to the Warsaw Rising Museum biography, Tadeusz Komorowski served in the Polish Army from November 1918. From August 1920 he commanded the 12th Uhlan Regiment and was wounded in the battle of Komarów on 31 August. From November 1928 to October 1938 he commanded the 9th Uhlan Regiment.

citations.quote: Od listopada 1918 r. służył w Wojsku Polskim
Od sierpnia 1920 r. dowódca 12. pułku ułanów
bitwy pod Komarowem 31 sierpnia, kiedy został ranny
od listopada 1928 do października 1938 dowódca 9. pułku ułanów

heading.zh-Hant: 1939年戰役與地下軍
heading.en: The 1939 campaign and the underground

body.zh-Hant: 據同一資料，1938年10月起他任騎兵訓練中心（格魯琪翁茨）指揮官；1939年9月3日起率部掩護維斯瓦河自卡爾瓦里亞山至登布林的河段。他在1940年2月出任波蘭武裝鬥爭聯盟（ZWZ）克拉科夫—西里西亞軍區司令，並自1941年7月起擔任 ZWZ 總司令（即救國軍司令）的副手。
body.en: According to the same record, from October 1938 he commanded the Cavalry Training Centre at Grudziądz; from 3 September 1939 he commanded the covering of the Vistula between Góra Kalwaria and Dęblin. In February 1940 he became commander of the Kraków–Silesia Area of the Union of Armed Struggle (ZWZ), and from July 1941 he was deputy to the ZWZ commander (the Home Army commander).

od lutego był komendantem Obszaru Kraków-Śląsk ZWZ
Od lipca 1941 r. zastępca Komendanta Głównego ZWZ - Dowódcy AK

heading.zh-Hant: 救國軍司令與華沙起義
heading.en: Home Army commander and the Warsaw Uprising

body.zh-Hant: 據華沙起義博物館資料，羅韋茨基將軍於1943年6月30日被捕後，他在7月接任救國軍（AK）司令，7月17日正式獲任。1944年7月31日他與政府代表揚·斯坦尼斯瓦夫·揚科夫斯基決定翌日發動華沙起義；起義部隊由蒙泰爾將軍指揮，而科莫羅夫斯基仍統率全國救國軍。1944年10月1日他指定奧庫利茨基為救國軍司令繼任人。
body.en: According to the Warsaw Rising Museum record, after General Rowecki was arrested on 30 June 1943 he took over as Home Army (AK) commander in July, formally appointed on 17 July. On 31 July 1944 he and the Government Delegate Jan Stanisław Jankowski decided to launch the Warsaw Uprising the next day; the insurgent forces were led by General "Monter", while Komorowski continued to command the Home Army as a whole. On 1 October 1944 he named Okulicki as his successor as Home Army commander.

citations.quote: Po aresztowaniu gen. "Grota" Roweckiego (30 VI 1943)
stanowisko Dowódcy AK (formalnie mianowany 17 lipca)
31 lipca 1944 r. wraz z Delegatem Rządu RP na Kraj
Siłami powstańczymi dowodził gen. "Monter"
nadal dowodził całością sił Armii Krajowej w kraju

heading.zh-Hant: 最高統帥任命與戰俘生涯
heading.en: Appointment as Commander-in-Chief and captivity

body.zh-Hant: 據 IPN 與華沙起義博物館，1944年9月30日波蘭流亡政府總統拉奇凱維奇任命他為最高統帥（Naczelny Wódz）。他自1944年10月5日起成為德軍戰俘，先後關押於紐倫堡附近的朗瓦瑟、科爾迪茨及阿爾卑斯山的馬克特蓬高戰俘營；1945年5月4日獲釋，28日在倫敦接任波蘭武裝部隊最高統帥。IPN 另記他在1947至1949年任流亡政府總理，1966年8月24日在英國去世。
body.en: According to the IPN and the Warsaw Rising Museum, on 30 September 1944 he was appointed Commander-in-Chief (Naczelny Wódz) by the President of the government in exile, Raczkiewicz. From 5 October 1944 he was a German prisoner of war, held successively at Oflag Langwasser near Nuremberg, Colditz and the Markt Pongau camp in the Alps; he was freed on 4 May 1945 and on 28 May took over as Commander-in-Chief of the Polish Armed Forces in London. The IPN also records that he was prime minister of the government in exile in 1947–1949 and that he died in Britain on 24 August 1966.

people.name: Józef Dowbor-Muśnicki
people.nameZh: 約瑟夫·多夫波爾－穆斯尼茨基

heading.zh-Hant: 俄軍時期：上校、參謀長與團長
heading.en: Russian service: colonel, chief of staff and regiment commander

body.zh-Hant: 據 IPN 的傳記，約瑟夫·多夫波爾－穆斯尼茨基（Józef Dowbor-Muśnicki）1867年10月25日生於加爾武夫，在俄軍服役。1908年3月2日他晉升上校；1910年任第11步兵師參謀長，兩年後應己請改任第7步兵師參謀長。1914年11月29日他被任命為第14西伯利亞步兵團團長，統率至1915年9月11日。
body.en: According to the IPN biography, Józef Dowbor-Muśnicki was born at Garbów on 25 October 1867 and served in the Russian army. He was promoted colonel on 2 March 1908; in 1910 he became chief of staff of the 11th Infantry Division and two years later, at his own request, moved to the same post in the 7th Infantry Division. On 29 November 1914 he was appointed commander of the 14th Siberian Rifle Regiment, which he led until 11 September 1915.

citations.quote: 2 marca 1908 r. został awansowany do stopnia pułkownika.
W 1910 r. objął stanowisko szefa sztabu 11. Dywizji Piechoty w Łucku.

29 listopada 1914 r. mianowany został dowódcą 14. Pułku Strzelców Syberyjskich
którym dowodził do 11 września 1915 r.

heading.zh-Hant: 第一波蘭軍團
heading.en: The Polish I Corps

body.zh-Hant: 據 IPN，1917年8月初俄軍總參謀部正式接受他出任第一波蘭軍（I Korpus Polski）軍長的人選。1918年1月中旬他下令各分散部隊在明斯克與博布魯伊斯克一帶集結，第1步兵師在羅哈喬夫一帶佔領陣地；2月3日夜，波蘭部隊奪取博布魯伊斯克。1918年5月21日該軍團簽署解散文件，他承擔全部責任。
body.en: According to the IPN, in early August 1917 the Russian general staff formally accepted his candidacy as commander of the Polish I Corps (I Korpus Polski). In mid-January 1918 he ordered the scattered units to concentrate around Minsk and Bobruisk, the 1st Rifle Division took up positions near Rogachev, and on the night of 3 February Polish detachments seized Bobruisk. On 21 May 1918 the document dissolving the corps was signed, and he took full responsibility.

heading.zh-Hant: 大波蘭起義與大波蘭戰線
heading.en: The Greater Poland Uprising and the Greater Poland Front

body.zh-Hant: 據 IPN，1918年11月13日皮爾蘇斯基邀請他前往華沙。1919年1月6日大波蘭人民議會（Naczelna Rada Ludowa）請他接掌大波蘭起義的指揮，他於1月16日從斯坦尼斯瓦夫·塔查克少校手中正式接任。1919年3月他晉升上將，並以大波蘭戰線司令的身分實際統率大波蘭軍；該戰線在1920年3月撤銷，他隨後幾乎沒有任職。
body.en: According to the IPN, on 13 November 1918 Piłsudski invited him to Warsaw. On 6 January 1919 the Supreme People's Council (Naczelna Rada Ludowa) called on him to take command of the Greater Poland Uprising, and on 16 January he formally took over the post from Major Stanisław Taczak. In March 1919 he was promoted general broni and, as commander of the Greater Poland Front, remained the effective commander of the Greater Poland Army; the front was dissolved in March 1920, after which he was left virtually without assignment.

heading.zh-Hant: 晚年
heading.en: Later years

body.zh-Hant: 據 IPN，他沒有接受戰爭部長一職或北方戰線的指揮，1920年7月波蘇戰爭局勢危急時他在波茲南附近的莊園。他此後約十七年務農、整理第一波蘭軍與大波蘭軍的檔案並撰寫回憶錄，1937年10月26日在巴托魯夫的莊園病逝。
body.en: According to the IPN, he did not accept the post of minister of military affairs or command of the northern front, and in July 1920, when the Bolshevik offensive threatened, he was at his estate near Poznań. For the last seventeen years of his life he farmed, put in order the records of the Polish I Corps and the Greater Poland forces and wrote his memoirs; he died after a long illness at his Batorów estate on 26 October 1937.
